title: Ivaldi version-control webhook route v1
description: The answer the control plane gives the gateway when it resolves a platform-wide webhook route key. The gateway caches it and uses it to route a normalized provider event.

organization_id.description: ID of the Organization the route key belongs to.

connection_id.description: ID of the Connection the route key belongs to.

host_url.description: Address of the provider, such as https://github.com or a self-hosted server.
